_help: Shareable 'Indian wedding guest dress code' cards (owner 27 Nov 2026 – reach). One card per community or function; every line comes from the quick answer of the linked guide – change the guide and this card together. product = a live product slug whose photo is shown.

cards.name: Tamil wedding
cards.wear: Silk saree (Kanjivaram) or a silk-look kurta set / Anarkali; men: kurta or veshti
cards.colours: Mustard, magenta, emerald, maroon, peacock blue
cards.tip: The muhurtham is early in the morning – shoulders covered, jasmine in your hair

cards.name: Bengali wedding
cards.wear: Silk saree, a rich Anarkali or an embroidered kurta set
cards.colours: Emerald, royal blue, magenta, purple, mustard
cards.avoid: Head-to-toe red (the bride's colour), plain white
cards.tip: The main wedding is usually in the evening – a little shine works

cards.name: Bangladeshi wedding
cards.wear: Saree, salwar kameez, Anarkali or sharara, arms and shoulders covered
cards.colours: Yellow, orange or green for the gaye holud; jewel tones for the biye
cards.avoid: Bridal red, plain white, all black at the main ceremony
cards.tip: Carry a dupatta or scarf if the nikah is in a mosque

cards.name: Punjabi wedding
cards.wear: Jewel-toned Anarkalis and embroidered kurta sets with a generous dupatta
cards.tip: Cover your head in the gurdwara and pick something you can dance in until midnight

cards.name: Sikh wedding (Anand Karaj)
cards.wear: A modest kurta set or salwar suit with a dupatta to cover the head
cards.colours: Soft or cheerful colours for the morning ceremony
cards.avoid: Short skirts, bare arms, uncovered hair inside the gurdwara
cards.tip: You will sit cross-legged on the floor – save the shine for the evening reception

cards.name: Pakistani wedding
cards.wear: Shalwar kameez, Anarkali frock, sharara or gharara with a dupatta
cards.colours: Yellow, green, orange for the mehndi; jewel tones for the baraat; pastels or rich evening colours for the walima
cards.tip: Keep arms and legs covered and carry your dupatta for the nikah

cards.name: Marathi wedding
cards.wear: Paithani or silk saree; or a chanderi kurta set, embroidered kurti or taffeta Anarkali
cards.colours: Green and yellow first; also pink, magenta, peacock blue, orange
cards.tip: Keep your hands free for the akshata (rice) and pin the dupatta to one shoulder

cards.name: Gujarati wedding
cards.wear: Flared Anarkali for garba, washable cotton for the pithi, a graceful kurta set or saree for the wedding day
cards.colours: Yellow or cheerful shades for the pithi
cards.avoid: Delicate silk or dry-clean-only pieces at the pithi
cards.tip: Drape the dupatta seedha-pallu style over the right shoulder on the wedding day

cards.name: Rajasthani / Marwari wedding
cards.wear: A flared georgette or chiffon Anarkali for ghoomar; a structured taffeta or gota suit for the pheras
cards.colours: Bright, bold colour with gota patti, bandhani or leheriya
cards.tip: Keep a dupatta handy to cover your head during rituals if the family does

cards.name: Kerala (Malayali) wedding
cards.wear: Cream kasavu saree with a gold border, set-mundu, silk saree – or a cream or pastel kurta set with gold detail
cards.colours: Cream and gold are traditional and welcome here
cards.tip: The ceremony is short and in the morning, followed by a sadya feast

cards.name: Nepali wedding
cards.wear: Saree or kurta suruwal; Anarkali, lehenga or a festive gown for the reception
cards.colours: Pink, green, yellow, orange, maroon, royal blue
cards.avoid: Red (the bride's colour), all white, all black
cards.tip: Bright, happy colours are the norm

cards.name: Mehndi
cards.wear: Cotton or georgette kurta set, Anarkali, sharara set or a light lehenga
cards.colours: Yellow, green, orange, pink, mustard – bandhani, leheriya and block print
cards.avoid: Long tight sleeves (your henna needs to dry)
cards.tip: Choose something you can sit on the floor in

cards.name: Haldi
cards.wear: A bright, breathable, washable cotton kurta set
cards.tip: It is daytime and messy with turmeric – comfort first

cards.name: Sangeet
cards.wear: A flared Anarkali or gown, a light suit set, a sharara or a georgette lehenga
cards.colours: Rani pink, teal, royal blue, emerald, purple, wine, gold
cards.avoid: Bridal red (unless the couple asks), stiff heavy fabric
cards.tip: Block heels, wedges or juttis – you will dance for hours

cards.name: Reception
cards.wear: A well-cut Anarkali or embroidered suit with one statement element
cards.tip: It is the most formal evening – graceful lines and polished accessories

cards.name: Winter wedding
cards.wear: A velvet Anarkali (dry clean only) with a light organza dupatta
cards.avoid: Thin summer fabric without a warm layer
cards.tip: For day functions, taffeta silk or a lined georgette Anarkali is lighter
